footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Caleres: includes a $2.3M income tax benefit, $3.2M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Jan 31, 2026 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 1.3% to $2.8B in fiscal 2025 (ended Jan 31, 2026). Gross margin was 43.0%, versus 44.9% a year earlier, and operating income fell 95.7% to $6.4M, a 0.2% margin.

The company had a net loss of $6.7M, or −$0.21 per share, versus net income of $107M. Operating cash flow was $103M and free cash flow $39.4M, versus $55.4M; Caleres returned $14.5M through dividends and buybacks.
watch: Net income includes a $2.3M tax benefit.
sources: Caleres, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
